description.value: The Sunshine Inn Houston is part of a four-property Northern BC chain strung along the Highway 16 corridor between Prince George and Prince Rupert, and is described as the newest of the four properties. It offers kitchenettes and air conditioning and positions itself as a comfortable stop for travellers heading to or through the Yellowhead region. Free parking and free Wi-Fi are standard across all chain locations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Houston-specific amenities page (/locations/houston/amenities-faq/) confirms the location is real and operating, listing kitchenettes, air conditioning, vending machines, and more, though the page is truncated. The front page and about page confirm free Wi-Fi chain-wide. No bike storage, tools, laundry, or bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site; continental breakfast is listed for Burns Lake, Smithers, and Terrace but Houston is not included in that list.
concerns: The Houston-specific amenities page (/locations/houston/amenities-faq/) is truncated in the fetched content (ends mid-sentence with 'Fr...'), so the full Houston amenity list could not be reviewed; additional amenities may exist.
Continental breakfast is explicitly listed as included only at Burns Lake, Smithers, and Terrace — Houston is omitted — but the website never states outright that Houston has no breakfast option.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with confirmed address, phone, and website; a practical overnight stop for cyclists on the Highway 16 touring corridor.

Vending machines.detail: Houston amenities page lists 'Vending Machine' among hotel amenities

Luggage storage.detail: FAQ states: 'Yes, we can look after your luggage free of charge. If you arrive early or are not ready to take your bags after checking out, we will store your goods for the day.'
